name: Spirit Parade
source: The story centers around Nara, a cynical 17-year-old girl who mostly shut herself off from the world after contracting spinal polio at a young age and becoming unable to walk. One night, a festival is going on in town. Instead of going with her family, Nara wanders off alone, not wanting to slow them down. As she goes through the various stalls, things become hazier and gradually Nara finds herself surrounded by people with ears, tails, and horns… and suddenly her clothes and wheelchair disappear! After a run-in with a rambunctious kitsune named Hayato and a scary-looking dragon officer of death named Shuye, Nara finds out that her soul has left her body and has been transported to the spirit world, where all the demons and spirits are celebrating a month-long festival. Until the end of this festival, she won’t be able to return home… Will Nara survive long enough in the spirit world to go back in one piece? Will she be able to get over her bitterness borne from the past, or will she be engulfed in hatred and lose sight of what’s truly important?
translation:
故事围绕娜拉展开：这名愤世嫉俗的17岁女孩幼年患脊髓灰质炎，无法行走，从此大多与世界隔绝。某晚，镇上举行祭典。娜拉不想拖累家人，没有跟家人一起去，而是独自离开。她穿过一个个摊位，周围逐渐变得模糊，最后发现自己被长着耳朵、尾巴与角的人包围……随后，她的衣服与轮椅突然消失！

她遇见吵闹的狐仙隼人与外表可怕、负责死亡事务的龙族官员舒耶后，得知自己的灵魂离开身体，被送到灵界。所有恶魔与精灵正在那里庆祝持续一月的祭典。在祭典结束前，她无法回家……娜拉能在灵界活下来并完整返回吗？她能克服过去产生的怨恨，还是会被仇恨吞噬，忘记真正重要的东西？
